venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.weather: A bit rainy through most of the daytime
venues.narrative: **MG — Monday 9/7, Labor Day (AM Braden & Lex; PM Justin & Marcus).** Total net sales $6,687 vs target $3,281 (+104%). Municipal Bar AM $2,774, PM $3,722; Sun Club $191; Hot Eye $0. Food $3,173. Comps $359.90. Guests 140 (AM 48 / PM 92 OpenTable), check avg $47.76. AM: busy Labor Day Monday start, steady from 9am through happy hour; team felt pressure from walk-ins (rain made it trickier) but came through with happy guests — note to schedule one heavier next 3-day-weekend Monday. PM: steady into early happy hour and start of dinner, slowed after 6pm with a few special reservations; Estella trained with Tia/Madi on support and menu. Sun Club: slow, familiar faces at the pool until rain at ~3pm. Hot Eye: N/A. Kitchen: slow night; very low on olives and mixed nuts (ordered, arriving tomorrow), no other lows/86s. No incidents. Favorite moment: Emm and family bouncing around the hotel outlets; Ezra's last Municipal visit before moving; hotel guests Angel & Mauricio got engaged during their stay; Arnold (305) and friends raving about the hotel art. Entered by Justin.

venues.name: D&C Seattle
venues.narrative: **SEA — Monday 9/7, Labor Day (MOD Curtis Hayes).** Net sales $11,650 vs target $10,000 (+16.5%). Food $1,577. Event $0. Comps $735.33 (6.3%) — a touch high from some bad batches and DNLs, plus two bigger comps for Nic (CDC for sea creatures) and Jordan (Le Coin, who brought a bottle of yellow VEP). 222 guests, $40.92 check avg. Some wonky business with a small door misfire but hopscotched folks around to keep the reservation scene alive; tighter turns 8–10pm as pre-gamed guests were more planted than the 4–7 pre-dinner crowd. First run of the patio — it needs music (Sonos speaker to be sorted, or use as casual hang/waiting area). Bar felt the heat but Alex T, Alexis and Gianni held it down; Tessa, Daisey and Alex S were moving on the floor with seamless table touches and drink running. Vibes consistent and hype all night; DCLA Hip Hop Mid 7–10pm is the move; ultra-dark lighting hits hard. Kitchen: ran a much smaller food menu, relieving stress; Wes held it down solo the last couple hours — menu will be condensed going forward. 86/low: Reserve Negroni (St George Repo), Hampden 8yr, Cinco Sentidos, Leopold Maryland Rye, Fossil and Fawn Chardonnay. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: seeing the team really own the shift. Entered by Curtis Hayes.
